The coastline is highly detailed with numerous inlets, bays, and small islands, particularly along the western edge, suggesting a complex geography.

entities.description: A light beige landmass with an irregular, jagged coastline is set against a solid light blue background. The shape features a broad upper section that tapers into a narrower, elongated lower portion with a distinct hook-like extension at the bottom.

A portion of a landmass with a light beige or off-white color, featuring an irregular coastline that meets a light blue body of water. The landmass has a smooth, flat appearance with no visible texture or features.

A pale beige landmass with an irregular, jagged coastline is depicted against a solid light blue background, resembling a map or satellite view. The landmass has a complex shape with multiple peninsulas and inlets, and its surface appears flat and uniform in color.

A map of the Balkan Peninsula, showing the countries of Greece, Albania, North Macedonia, Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and parts of Croatia, Romania, and Turkey. The landmass is depicted in a light beige color with thin black lines indicating national borders, while the surrounding bodies of water, including the Adriatic Sea, Ionian Sea, Aegean Sea, and Black Sea, are shown in a light blue color.

A long, narrow island with an irregular coastline, featuring a prominent headland on the left and a smaller, separate islet to the far right. The landmass is depicted in a light beige color against a pale blue background, with a few small dark spots indicating specific locations or features on the island.
